[SWS_DM_00846] Notification about security-level change
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04208
⌈
If the
Diagnostic Server instance
did successfully change the security-level
of a conversation, it shall update the security level of according
ara::diag::Con-
versation
class instance internally. Whether a security level is applicable by the
DiagnosticSecurityAccess
is defined by
securityLevel
.
